description:
The current Maven project 'dependency-cleanup' has accumulated several unused dependencies in its pom.xml. Your task is to identify and remove ONLY the dependencies that are not used in the source code. 

1. Analyze the project sources (src/main/java and src/test/java) to determine which libraries are actually imported and used.
2. Remove the unused dependencies from pom.xml.
3. Ensure the project still compiles and all tests pass after your changes.

Do not remove dependencies that are actually used. Do not modify the Java source code.
